# Markov

> The mandate layer for Solana: non-custodial accounts where AI agents and human strategists operate an owner's capital under program-enforced policy — venue and token allowlists, caps, x402 spend budgets, expiry, instant revocation. Every action and every refusal emits a verifiable receipt. Float is the consumer surface: operator marketplace, live console with kill switch, and a pause/revoke-only Telegram agent. Protocol and SDKs are open source; receipts are meant to compound into operator scores, bonds, and eventually credit (not in this prototype).

Key facts: withdrawal authority never leaves the owner; refusals carry machine-readable BlockReason codes; the emergency key can only pause and revoke; unpause is owner-only; no token exists.

This file describes **this repository** (Phase 0 monorepo). URLs below are live only if listed in `docs/FACTS.md`.
